name: Bodhisattva
summary: This gilt bronze figure represents a Bodhisattva, a holy being who has obtained the final enlightenment and has chosen to return to the world to help humanity. It is a very rare example of devotional image from the Eastern Wei dynasty (534-550). Images of Bodhisattva were used in temples and shrines

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
